Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the second step by misinterpreting the role of the organizations involved. The task asks for the person who started the organization that *founded* (initiated/launched) the Defective by Design campaign. The WebSurfer correctly identified that the FSF and CivicActions jointly launched the campaign. The Planner incorrectly assumed that because CivicActions is listed as a partner/organizer, it is the sole "organization that founded" the campaign, thereby excluding the Free Software Foundation (FSF). This exclusion led the Planner to ignore the fact that the FSF was the primary driver and that the FSF itself was founded by Richard Stallman. By failing to recognize that the "organization that founded" the campaign could be the FSF (which was founded by Stallman), the Planner diverted the search to finding the founders of CivicActions (Henry Poole and Aaron Pava), leading to the wrong final answer.
